source_context_translations.translation: The Dao that can be spoken is not the constant Dao; the name that can be named is not the constant name.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): A physical route or track for travel and movement.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Concrete and spatial, not abstract or philosophical.
Sentence Translations (English): Traveling in the mountains, he saw a very narrow path.
This road leads beyond the city.
Ahead there is a broad road fit for carts and horses.
He lost the path and could not go on.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): A procedure, technique, or approach used to accomplish something.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Refers to a practical means or method, not the cosmic Dao.
Sentence Translations (English): There is a proper method for ruling a state.
The way of learning lies in diligence.
The method of warfare is to use the few to defeat the many.
The way of governance is first to rectify oneself.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To utter words or state something orally or in writing; the verbal use of the term.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Common literary verb of saying; not the noun 'Way'.
Sentence Translations (English): The Master said: I dare not say it.
Everyone spoke of his goodness.
The historian recorded it truthfully.
The guest slowly told what he had heard.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental, all-embracing principle or course of reality and proper conduct; in this text, the ultimate Way that cannot be fully formulated.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): In philosophical context it denotes an ultimate principle, not an ordinary route.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): Indicates that something is fitting, allowable, or good enough in judgment or circumstance.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Evaluative, not modal; often means 'decent' or 'worthy of approval'.
Sentence Translations (English): This plan is acceptable.
His words are also reasonable.
What he did may not be proper.
This person is rather worthy.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To agree to something, grant permission, or regard an action as acceptable.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Requires an object or implied action, not mere possibility.
Sentence Translations (English): The lord did not approve his request.
His parents had not consented to the marriage.
All approved it.
The ruler then approved the proposal.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): Expresses possibility, capability, or permission: something may be done, is able to be done, or can be the case.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): In this text it introduces potentiality rather than approval.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): Indicates that an action, judgment, or statement is incorrect or not right.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Judgmental or corrective, not simple sentential negation.
Sentence Translations (English): His words were truly wrong.
This strategy is gravely improper.
Knowing that it is not wrong, one may then discuss it.
What he did there was all wrong.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To censure or disapprove of someone or something.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Expresses active criticism, not merely factual negation.
Sentence Translations (English): Everyone criticized him.
A ruler should not blame his minister.
The villagers often criticized me.
A mother could not bear to blame her son.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): Marks simple negation of a predicate or statement; it denies that something is the case.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Plain predicate negation; do not confuse with the later set phrase 非常.
